title: Fire & Smoke Mitigation Labor, Contents Handling, Debris and PPE Rates
content:
Rate sheet for the Fire & Smoke Mitigation crew items that are not surface cleaning: moving contents within a room, debris removal, protective equipment and hourly labor, together with the multiplier for labor in the after-hours or holiday window.

## Items

- Contents manipulation: Moving and blocking contents within the room per room, USD.
- Debris haul: Debris haul-off per pickup-truck load, USD.
- Dumpster: Roll-off dumpster (30 cubic yard) per placement, USD.
- PPE: PPE per technician per day, USD.
- Technician labor: Fire and smoke technician labor per hour, business-hours rate, USD.
- Supervisor labor: Supervisor labor per hour, business-hours rate, USD.
- After-hours labor multiplier: Multiplier on hourly labor rates for labor performed in the after-hours or holiday window, decimal.

## Rates by tier

| Tier | Contents manipulation, per room (USD) | Debris haul, per load (USD) | Dumpster, per placement (USD) | PPE, per technician-day (USD) | Technician, per hour (USD) | Supervisor, per hour (USD) | After-hours labor multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Smoke Odor Response | 64.80 | 214.00 | 0.00 | 18.40 | 78.50 | 96.40 | 1.5 |
| Light Smoke and Soot Cleanup | 64.80 | 214.00 | 0.00 | 24.60 | 78.50 | 96.40 | 1.5 |
| Moderate Fire and Smoke Cleanup | 64.80 | 214.00 | 685.00 | 28.75 | 82.40 | 99.80 | 1.5 |
| Heavy Fire Cleanup | 72.40 | 238.00 | 685.00 | 46.20 | 86.75 | 104.60 | 1.5 |
| Structural Fire Large Loss | 65.16 | 214.20 | 616.50 | 46.20 | 82.40 | 99.80 | 1.5 |
| Commercial Fire Large Loss | 65.16 | 214.20 | 616.50 | 46.20 | 86.75 | 104.60 | 1.5 |

## Notes

- The hourly figures are business-hours rates. The multiplier of 1.5 is the same on every tier.
- The dumpster figure is 0.00 on Smoke Odor Response and Light Smoke and Soot Cleanup and 685.00 or 616.50 on the higher tiers.
- PPE is priced per technician per day, so its quantity is counted in technician-days.

## Hypothetical illustration

Four hypothetical business-hours supervisor hours on a Smoke Odor Response job are 4 hours at 96.40, which is 385.60; two hypothetical debris loads on a Moderate Fire and Smoke Cleanup job are 2 at 214.00, which is 428.00.
